name: marx
description: A desktop client for Checkmarx One SAST and SCA scans
author: Marx contributors

scripts.typecheck: bun --bun tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && bun --bun tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json
scripts.verify:cli: bun run build && bun --bun electron scripts/verify-cli.cjs
scripts.build: bun run clean:dist && bun --bun electron-vite build
scripts.dist: bun run build && bun --bun electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: bun run build && bun --bun electron-builder --dir --publish never
scripts.screenshot: bun run build && bun --bun electron scripts/capture-screenshot.cjs
scripts.dist:mac: bun run build && bun --bun electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:win: bun run build && bun --bun electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win:dir: bun run build && bun --bun electron-builder --win --x64 --dir --publish never
scripts.dist:win:arm64: bun run build && bun --bun electron-builder --win --arm64 --publish never
